sections.title: Decentralizing the Giant: Machine Learning Verification
sections.body: Gensyn is a protocol that enables a global, decentralized supercomputer where every computation is mathematically verified. Kenya AI Compute is positioning itself as a core infrastructure provider for the Gensyn network in the EMEA region. Our facility provides the stable, high-TDP environment required for Gensyn’s verification nodes and training workers. By participating in Gensyn, we contribute to a future where AI training is no longer gatekept by a few centralized entities. For our project, this means another high-utilization revenue stream that values our low energy cost and industrial-grade hardware reliability. As the protocol moves toward mainnet, our Kenyan site will be among the first to offer large-scale, verified compute blocks to global researchers. Additional context: the project follows a clear rollout roadmap that aligns low-cost energy, infrastructure reliability, and flex

sections.title: Gensyn Integration Features
items: Hardware Compatibility: Optimized GPU clusters for compute-intensive verification tasks.
Protocol Alignment: Direct support for Gensyn’s probabilistic proof-of-learning.
Energy Efficiency: $0.04/kWh ensures our nodes are highly competitive in the protocol’s auction system.
Global Access: Providing a localized gateway for African AI researchers to use Gensyn resources.
Scalability: Ready to dedicate up to 30% of Phase 2 capacity to the Gensyn ecosystem.
